purpose: Independent simulated beginner mouse-only RILL session; UI observations only.
persona: Simulated first-time beginner interested in a short relaxed lo-fi sketch.

rating_reasons.easy_to_use: Visible double-click and Pencil hints led directly to an instrument and notes; Duplicate, faders and pan worked with mouse actions. The playback failure interrupted an otherwise approachable workflow.
rating_reasons.how_cool_it_looks: The dark interface, teal waveform and colored note display looked cohesive and readable; the large empty mixer area felt sparse.
rating_reasons.how_fast_it_is: Editing and navigation responded promptly. Repeated playback failure needed Retry, and the 30-second WAV export showed several seconds of progress before completion. This is a session impression, not a benchmark.
rating_reasons.how_confusing_it_is: Most controls had clear labels. Add send opened routing requiring another + Send, and the recurring output-stream warning left uncertainty about instrument playback.
rating_reasons.feature_completeness: I could discover audio and MIDI editing, VST assignment, mixer volume/pan/mute/solo, a bus/send, project naming/saving, and WAV/MIDI export. Reliable playback was not established for the full piece.

findings.observation: The empty-arrangement hint led to double-clicking for MIDI. Device library exposed Rill Lab Sine and Assign instrument created a track and pattern.
Pencil drag created four labeled notes C4, E4, G4, F4. Duplicate repeated clips; Fit revealed the final audio edge, and trimming plus repeated MIDI clips produced a visible 0:30.000 arrangement.

The first Play attempt showed Audio output stream failed or disconnected. A similar warning reappeared after brief retry playback and mute/solo experimentation. Stable full-piece playback was not established.
Retry playback changed Play to Pause, advanced the transport to 002.04.86 and displayed active drum/master meters. No sound was auditioned.
Mixer fader drags visibly changed drums to -8.2 dB and instrument to -6.6 dB; pan drags produced L15 and R14. Mute and Solo visibly highlighted when clicked and were then turned off.

Add bus created a New bus strip immediately. Drum Add send opened routing, requiring a second + Send and target selection. The resulting send displayed New bus, 0.25x and Post, and the mixer showed Bus 1 in.
File > Rename project exposed an onscreen Keyboard; clicking its letters entered dusk. The project save dialog suggested dusk.rill in session-1 and closed after OK.
WAV export showed Arrangement 0:30. I unchecked effect tails and accepted dusk.wav. Exported notices appeared for both dusk.wav and dusk.mid after their UI save operations.

outcome.status: Completed through UI: named and saved a 30-second audio/MIDI arrangement, adjusted mixer controls, created a bus/send, and saw both export success notices. Playback reliability and file contents remain unverified.
outcome.composition: Four consecutive copies of the starter Circuit rhythm audio, with the last trimmed to two bars, plus fourteen one-bar MIDI patterns containing C4, E4, G4, F4 at 112 BPM. Drums are panned L15 and instrument R14; drums also send to New bus.
outcome.playback_observed: First Play failed with an output-stream warning. Retry produced an advancing transport, Pause button and active drum/master meters. Later solo showed blank meters and an output-stream warning subsequently reappeared. Full 30-second playback and instrument sound were not established. App left stopped.

limitations: No file contents were inspected and no audio was auditioned; independent coordinator verification follows.
Paths are based on visible save dialogs and filenames, not filesystem verification.
Software graphics and a timer-paced virtual audio sink with 60 ms buffering; playback errors and timing cannot be generalized to a physical setup.
Only the provided Rill Lab Sine VST3 was used; no claim about other third-party plug-ins.
Screenshot 30-wav-success.png actually captured export progress; the success notice is in 31-wav-status.png.

mixer_outcome.volume: Dragged drum and instrument faders; visible values changed from -6.0 to -8.2 dB and -2.5 to -6.6 dB. Balance chosen visually, not by hearing.
mixer_outcome.pan: Dragged drum pan left and instrument pan right; labels changed to Pan L15 and Pan R14.
mixer_outcome.mute: Clicked instrument Mute; button highlighted orange, then clicked again to turn off. No audible mute claim.
mixer_outcome.solo: Clicked instrument Solo; button highlighted teal, then clicked again to turn off. Meters were blank in the solo screenshot, with a subsequent output-stream warning, so audibility was not established.
mixer_outcome.bus: Clicked Add bus; New bus strip appeared with 0.0 dB and centered pan. After adding send it showed Bus 1 in.
mixer_outcome.send: Clicked drum Add send, then + Send, then New bus. Routing displayed a New bus send at 0.25x Post; mixer displayed Send · New bus.
